works.title: Dracula’s Guest and Other Weird Stories

note: THE ROOM HOLDS THE NOVEL ENTIRE AND A SET OF PASSAGES INTO IT. The seven excerpts are the way in — the castle door, the crawl, the three sisters, the bloofer lady, Van Helsing on the Un-Dead, the death of the Count, and Dracula's Guest complete. The twenty-seven chapters below them are the whole book, split by chapter and unedited. Stoker names the document type at the head of every one, which is why this novel can be staged as a cast recording: a journal, a letter, a ship's log, a phonograph diary, a newspaper cutting. The chapter files are also what the Amenti Studios cutter reads when it proposes a cue sheet.
